edits.original: - Group avoidance rule configuration: sets "avoidance groups" for each prize (e.g., prize "Technology Department Exclusive Coupon" needs to avoid "Product Department" group), supports multiple group selection.
edits.modified: - Group avoidance rule configuration: sets "avoidance groups" for each prize (e.g., prize "Technology Department Exclusive Coupon" needs to avoid "Product Department" group); members of avoidance groups remain eligible but are drawn after other members, supports multiple group selection.

edits.original: - Supports two list loading modes: loading built-in default team building list (containing name, department group information); uploading custom txt list (format: each line "Name,Department Group", e.g., "Zhang San,Technology Department").
edits.modified: - Supports two list loading modes: loading built-in default team building list (containing name, department group information); uploading custom txt list (format: each line "Name,Department Group", e.g., "Zhang San;Technology Department").

edits.original: - Basic filtering logic: during each lottery round, automatically excludes previous winners and members of current prize's "avoidance groups".
edits.modified: - Basic filtering logic: during each lottery round, automatically excludes previous winners and members of current prize's "avoidance groups", with no exceptions for any lottery person.
